title: Getstrength Front Squat and Zercher Harness Promo
actuallyObserved: Manufacturer-linked embedded player at33s and43s, then YouTube cinema player at29s and34s. A later paused72s view depicts the distinct Zercher load position, not the front-squat bar height.
newSourceFact: The regular harness is worn on padded arches over the medial upper shoulder/trap region beside the neck. Front views show low forearms/elbows stabilising the harness/bar. Outer deltoid-cap placement is not a general requirement of this apparatus.
scopeLimit: The real wearer is not the illustrated athlete. This does not recover the source body camera/depth, validate the draft by itself, or measure a51mm anatomical clearance. Only direct final native review can decide visible support and clearance.
